content.summary: Implemented claude-agent-sdk native routing in LLM.stream

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: AC-1: Detect when model uses claude-agent-sdk provider
AC-2: Route claude-agent-sdk models to native streamClaudeNative()
AC-3: Keep all other providers on existing streamText() path
AC-4: Pass OpenCode session ID properly to native path
AC-5: Ensure tools from ToolRegistry are available to native path
AC-6: Return stream compatible with existing SessionProcessor consumption

data.notes: Native claude-agent-sdk routing now builds a LanguageModelV2 prompt with system messages, resumes SDK sessions via ClaudeAgentSDKSessionStore, and wraps native streams with a lazy text accessor for summary/title flows.
